description.first_3_lines_above_fold:
Every time you promise to change your life at 2:00 AM, your brain is already setting a trap. Here is the neurobiology of why Day 4 always collapses, and how consistent people eliminate willpower entirely.

Subscribe to uncover how your mind actually works.
